name: ELIOB.fr
positioning: A CRM built for credit brokers to run their firm without losing track of a file.
description: ELIOB.fr is a French SaaS CRM for credit brokerage firms. It brings together client files, partners, documents, invoicing and activity tracking in one workspace built around a single, structured borrower dossier.
real_estate_use: A broker or brokerage firm uses ELIOB.fr to keep one structured file per client — contacts, supporting documents, partner banks and history — and to follow a loan project continuously from the first contact through financing and invoicing, instead of scattering that information across email and spreadsheets.
features: Continuous project tracking from first contact to financing

use_cases.job: Track a borrower's loan file and partner communications from first contact to closing
Centralize a brokerage firm's clients, documents and invoicing in one workspace
